fields.summary_ko.0: Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) fell 39% over one month, but 24/7 Wall St. set a price target of $232, suggesting 38% upside potential and assigned a BUY rating.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q2 revenue grew 36.55% and Data Center revenue increased 46%, accounting for 79% of total revenue, with potential for 2029 guidance raises from a customized silicon contract with Google.
